item.title: Welcome
item.description: OpenKeyNav gives developers an open-source JavaScript toolkit for adding an optional keyboard interaction layer to websites and web applications.
item.content:encoded:
OpenKeyNav gives developers an open-source JavaScript toolkit for adding an optional keyboard interaction layer to websites and web applications.

Why OpenKeyNav?​

People who cannot or do not use a mouse need keyboard access. This group includes people who use alternative input devices through a keyboard interface. Developers often make dense interfaces and drag-and-drop interactions depend on a pointer.

OpenKeyNav adds keyboard paths for those interactions. Developers must also provide semantic HTML, native controls, established keyboard conventions, and accessibility testing.

Key Features of OpenKeyNav​

  • On-demand target labels: OpenKeyNav can display short labels that provide a direct route to detected controls in dense interfaces.
  • Complex interactions: Configured keyboard drag-and-drop and movement modes can provide an alternative to pointer-only operation.
  • Customizable activation keys: Developers can adapt the mode keys to their application and test for browser, operating-system, and assistive-technology conflicts.
  • Development diagnostics: OpenKeyNav debug labels flag likely mouse-only targets for manual investigation. Developers must verify every result.
  • Optional interaction layer: Users can enable or disable the shortcuts and keep using conventional keyboard behavior.

Getting Started​

Start with one interaction. Preserve its conventional keyboard behavior and evaluate the complete task before expanding the integration.

Follow the Getting Started Guide to install and initialize OpenKeyNav.

Comprehensive Documentation​

Developers can find setup instructions, examples, configuration options, limitations, and testing guidance in the OpenKeyNav documentation.

Looking Ahead​

Maintainers use implementation work, research, and adopter feedback to improve OpenKeyNav interactions, documentation, and test coverage.

Feedback​

Developers can report implementation problems and documentation gaps through the OpenKeyNav project.

The OpenKeyNav Team
